role: Backup mechanical qualification only; ROD remains the active research line.
scope: One primary-anchored projection of the auxiliary gradient. No source acquisition, model training, checkpoint selection, account replay or change to sealed cards/release.

source.requirement: Resolve the exact saved original shared-head models, tensors, feature order, scaler, candidate/spec and source hashes through the source manifest and Qlib Recorder. Do not substitute domain-head models or current dirty providers.
source.source_drift: Missing identity, hash mismatch or incompatible original structure stops preflight for review; no reconstruction by refitting.

anchors.name: original_initialization
anchors.definition: Construct the original nonlinear shared-head network with the original seed and saved spec; no optimizer step.

anchors.name: saved_base_outer_final
anchors.definition: Load the corresponding saved base_outer model final tensors; do not replay its training.

fixed_probe_grid.enumeration: Cartesian product seeds x anchors x epoch indices, in the listed order; retain every probe.
fixed_probe_grid.interpretation: Epoch indices select only the original auxiliary RNG stream at each fixed anchor. They are not intermediate training checkpoints and do not reconstruct a training trajectory.
fixed_probe_grid.no_adaptive_expansion: No additional seeds, anchors, draws, epochs or ordering changes in response to results.

training_domain.primary: All original primary rows whose saved label_available_at is strictly before cutoff, with the original maturity and finite-label rules.
training_domain.auxiliary: Original PIT auxiliary rows, order and training_weight; observations_end <= train_end; no relabeling or backfill.
training_domain.sampling: torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed * 1000 + epoch_index); torch.randint with replacement; min(2048, auxiliary_rows) indices.
training_domain.weights: Original auxiliary training_weight normalized by its full eligible training-domain mean; preserve original per-row weighted mean reduction.
training_domain.evaluation_data: No evaluation/forward labels or returns are read. Mature training labels are read only if this unexecuted preflight is separately approved.

task_grouping.allocation: Exact original allocation objective, including the original 10 bp training cost proxy and 0.006 turnover coefficient; do not split or reweight its components.
task_grouping.flattening: Use the explicit parameter lists above and original tensor order. Missing shared gradients fail; zero auxiliary gradients on private parameters are represented explicitly.

single_intervention.gradient_definitions: gP = grad(P, shared); gA = grad(A, shared), including the fixed original coefficients.
single_intervention.rule: If ||gP||_2^2 == 0, keep gA. Otherwise gA_projected = gA - min(0, dot(gP,gA)) / ||gP||_2^2 * gP.
single_intervention.protected_gradient: gP is never projected or rescaled by this intervention.
single_intervention.private_gradient: Keep the original primary/private gradient without projection.
single_intervention.assembly: Shared = gP + gA_projected; private = original primary/private gradient.
single_intervention.projection_arithmetic: Keep original forward/autograd dtype. Use float64 only for the small dot products, norm squared and projection arithmetic; cast the modified auxiliary vector back to the original gradient dtype. If no conflict or zero primary norm, return the original auxiliary tensor unchanged.
single_intervention.ordering: Exactly one auxiliary-to-primary projection; no symmetric PCGrad, task shuffling, iterative projection or new RNG consumption.
single_intervention.unchanged_optimizer_contract: Assemble all 973 gradients, apply the original single global clip_grad_norm_(max_norm=2.0), then the original AdamW with all saved hyperparameters unchanged in any separately designed future experiment.
single_intervention.preflight_optimizer_execution: No optimizer step is executed in this preflight. Clip coefficients and clipped gradient vectors may be computed read-only after approval.

matched_control.definition: Original combined loss backward, P + A, on identical tensors, auxiliary indices, row weights and initialization/final anchor.
matched_control.split_control: Compute grad(P) + grad(A) separately and compare to original combined backward before any projection.
invariants: Initial primary and auxiliary forward outputs
matched_control.not_controls: The failed detach and domain-head candidates are historical context, not replacements for the original matched control.

numerical_screen_proposal.interpretation: A fixed dtype-scaled numerical screen, not a rigorous bound on all upstream autograd/GEMM accumulation errors, an economic gate, or a claim of mathematical equality.
numerical_screen_proposal.definitions: eps = finfo(original_gradient_dtype).eps; r = 32 * eps; all audit norms/dots accumulated in float64; u64 = finfo(float64).eps / 2; gamma(k) = k*u64/(1-k*u64).
numerical_screen_proposal.split_backward_tolerance: tau_sum = r * (||grad(P)_all||_2 + ||grad(A)_all||_2). Require ||grad(P+A)_all - (grad(P)_all + grad(A)_all)||_2 <= tau_sum. If the scale is zero, require exact equality.
numerical_screen_proposal.private_projection_check: Pre-clip private gradient copied from the split control must be bitwise unchanged; post-global-clip private magnitudes need not match because the common clip coefficient may change.
numerical_screen_proposal.materially_resolvable_projection: All mechanical checks pass, dot(gP,gA) < -tau_dot, and ||gA_projected-gA||_2 > tau_projection after casting back to the original dtype.
numerical_screen_proposal.numerically_indistinguishable: Projection is exactly unchanged, or its change is <= tau_projection, or the negative dot does not exceed tau_dot. This means unresolved under this prespecified screen, not proof that the real-valued gradients coincide.
numerical_screen_proposal.direction_check: Before and after the positive global clipping factor, report dot(grad(P), assembled_gradient) and dot(grad(L_allocation), assembled_gradient), for both control and candidate; include shared-only and full-parameter results. Apply the same dot-error formula using the corresponding vector dimension when interpreting a sign.
numerical_screen_proposal.no_threshold_injection: These bounds classify audit resolution only. The projection rule itself remains strict dot < 0; no angle threshold is inserted into the method.
numerical_screen_proposal.failure_rule: If split backward exceeds its fixed allowance, dtype/backend is unsupported, or the reviewer finds the bound unjustified, status is needs_numerical_review. Do not widen tolerances, reclassify the case as harmless rounding, or proceed to fitting.
numerical_screen_proposal.assembly_dtype_contract: Compute grad(P)+grad(A) in the original gradient dtype, using the same assembly order as the proposed candidate. Cast assembled vectors to float64 only for audit residuals/norms/dots. No float64 control sum that hides original-dtype assembly effects.
numerical_screen_proposal.split_shared_backward_tolerance: Additionally require ||grad(P+A)_shared - (grad(P)_shared+grad(A)_shared)||_2 <= r*(||grad(P)_shared||_2+||grad(A)_shared||_2), with sum assembled in original dtype before float64 audit. Zero shared scale requires exact equality. All24probes must pass BOTH full973 and shared154 parity; any failure is needs_numerical_review without tolerance/sample expansion.
numerical_screen_proposal.dot_bound_limit: gamma(308) concerns only float64 dot-product rounding. The2r+r^2 term is a perturbation budget assuming each vector has relative perturbation at most r; neither full nor shared split parity proves this as an upstream autograd error bound.

required_evidence: All 24 source/shape/count/finite checks and split-backward equivalence checks
Private parameters unprojected; primary gradient unchanged by projection
All conflict and projection-displacement measurements, including identities
Composite P and allocation-only directional quantities, without claiming that protection of P protects allocation alone
mechanical_decision.all_identity_or_unresolved: Do not start fits. Close this fixed preflight as no_resolvable_intervention_at_prespecified_anchors; do not change draws, anchors, coefficients or tolerance to rescue it.
mechanical_decision.any_resolvable_change: Mechanism is identifiable only at these frozen probes. It may be considered for a separate frozen training-and-complete-account design; this file does not authorize that design or execution.
mechanical_decision.invalid_or_missing: Stop at the concrete source/numerical failure and request review; no automatic substitute or optimizer reconstruction.

limits.raw_first_order: For a nonzero gP, the exact Euclidean un-clipped composite direction satisfies dot(gP, gP+gA_projected) >= ||gP||^2. Positive global clipping preserves its sign but can dilute its magnitude.
limits.not_allocation_guarantee: P includes the original primary BCE terms; protection of this composite does not guarantee improvement in allocation loss alone, classification generalization or net SOXX excess.
limits.adamw: Raw Euclidean direction protection does not imply protection after AdamW momentum, coordinatewise preconditioning and decoupled weight decay.
limits.optimizer_state_policy: Do not create, zero-fill, infer or reconstruct unsaved AdamW states. No actual update protection is measured or certified; real_step_protection remains unknown.
limits.trajectory: Initialization/final anchors and four auxiliary draws do not describe the intervening training trajectory, conflict frequency during fitting, curvature or out-of-sample usefulness.
limits.no_optimization_claim: No return expectation, promotion claim, controller change or production release change.

existing_evidence.interpretation: Existing all-auxiliary gradients at one frozen checkpoint were near-orthogonal and positive; they did not establish negative transfer. They are not original 2048-row sampled gradients or a reconstructed optimizer trajectory.
existing_evidence.novelty: Conditional removal of only the conflicting auxiliary component; not permanent detach, cloned output heads, loss-weight search or full-path STE.

references.community_boundary: General multi-loss discussion only. No verified SOXL/SOXX or quantitative-trading PCGrad efficacy evidence was found.
references.adaptation: One-dimensional primary-gradient subspace, preserve orthogonal and aligned auxiliary components and discard the conflicting component. This is a restricted asymmetric adaptation, not a full reproduction of symmetric PCGrad or tuned ATTITTUD.

preflight_review_amendment.change: Added shared-local parity and explicit original-dtype assembly; r, algorithm, probe grid and training/source scope unchanged. No execution.
